name: Meddle
description:
Trigger: a creature within medium range makes a skill check or damage roll.

If the trigger is a skill check, it becomes favored or ill-favored (your choice).

If the trigger is a damage roll, upgrade or downgrade each die in the roll by one die size. A d10 becomes a d12 or d8, etc. A downgraded d4 is removed from the roll entirely. The creature still adds any modifiers to the total.

Either way, check a Condition.

Describe how you intervene.
